missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Неделя' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Эта' points at the current week, and 'тяжёлой' is the instrumental predicate after 'была'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Неделю' is the accusative form expressing the span spent at home. 'Всю' agrees in the feminine accusative.

missions.phrase: В начале недели было много работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Недели' is the genitive form after 'в начале', showing which part of the week. 'Много работы' is the genitive quantity.

missions.phrase: К концу недели я очень устал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Недели' is the genitive form after 'к концу', marking time toward the week's end. 'Устал' is the past-tense predicate.

missions.phrase: Между неделей и месяцем большая разница.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Неделей' is the instrumental form after 'между', compared with 'месяцем'. 'Разница' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: На прошлой неделе мы ездили в лес.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'На неделе' uses the prepositional form 'неделе' after 'на' to express when. 'Прошлой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Неделю' is the accusative form after 'через', marking a future point in time. 'Каникулы' is the plural subject.

missions.phrase: Я был в отпуске две недели.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after a numeral. 'Недели' is the genitive singular form required after 'две'. The phrase counts the length of the vacation.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Недели' is the nominative plural subject of 'были'. 'Последние' agrees as the plural adjective, and 'холодными' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Недель' is the genitive plural after 'несколько', expressing an indefinite count. 'Прошло' is the neuter past-tense verb.
